messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled config-only deployment for inference-svc -> change-set: `routing-batching-timeouts-v2`

Amanda: heads-up — since we had the model flip last week, are we pinning model versions for this change?

Josh: yes, pinning routes to redwood-model-v3.1.4 across the service. No model upgrades during the rollout window.

Priya: perf team notes:
- reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 for latency-sensitive routes
- keep throughput routes at 64 but bump batch_timeout_ms to 30 for better packing
- increase per-request timeout to 30000ms for longer generations
- routing: prefer us-west-2, then us-east-1; fallback to dedicated-pool if region capacity low

Marco: Canary plan?

Josh: Canary: 3% (10m) -> 15% (20m) -> 100%. Monitoring: p95 latency, error_rate, token_cost. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate >= 1.5% sustained over 5m OR p95 > 1200ms for 5m.

Priya: also will run prompt_set_042 eval after canary step completes to check for quality regressions.

Amanda: draft release notes I'll post to #releases after the deploy:
- Config-only update: adjusted batching/timeouts and routing priorities to lower token costs while keeping latency targets.
- Model pinned to v3.1.4 for stability during rollout.
- Canary rollout with automated rollback guards.

Marco: adding runbook + rollback command to deploy message. Rollback command for console: `rwdctl deployments rollback --service inference-svc --to-config last-known-good`

Josh: change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Kicking off at 02:05 UTC to give 5m buffer. I'll monitor first canary. @Priya @Amanda please stand by. :eyes:

oncall-bot: Reminder: incident window rules apply. If oncall escalates, pause rollout and escalate to eng-sre.

Priya: noted — I'll post eval results and quick diffs for top-10 prompts after canary. If any quality regression detected, we rollback immediately.

Amanda: will post release notes and link to runbook once Marco adds it.

Josh: proceeding -> deploy queued. Will abort and run rollback command if thresholds crossed.
